subject: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing

Team —

Kicking off a short planning thread to align on FY27 target hypotheses and the scenario matrix we'll use for the QBR. Goal is a crisp, executable plan we can share with the board and sales leaders on the 6/18 QBR prep deadline. Key asks below: 

1) Owners: I want each of you to own one scenario and produce topline delta impacts (revenue, unit economics, capacity) by next Wed (5/14).
2) Deck: use the attached qbr_template_v2.pptx — we'll consolidate inputs into a single narrative.
3) Timeline: see attached planning_timeline_v1.xlsx; please flag any conflicts.
4) Hypotheses: initial list in scenario_hypotheses_v1.md — add 1–2 non-consensus items you think matter.

Scenarios (base wording for discussion):
- Base: modest growth, current conversion rates, conservative hiring
- Upside: improved enterprise land rate + 15% ARPA
- Downside: slower consumption, 10% headcount hiring freeze

Please reply with: a) which scenario you own, b) earliest time you can do a 30m sync if needed, c) any blockers (procurement, data, GAAP questions).

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing

Jonas — happy to take Upside. Quick notes: 
- Topline sketch attached (short table in body + full numbers in scenario_hypotheses_v1.md). Upside assumes 15% ARPA lift from product pricing + landing two mid-market channel partners.
- Sync: I can do 5/12 10am or 5/14 2pm PT for a quick walkthrough.
- Blockers: need an updated churn cohort by 5/13 (Data/CS).

I'll add a short slide draft to the Drive link.

Marissa
Director, GTM Insights
Redwood Inference
Attachment: scenario_hypotheses_v1.md (section: Upside sketch)

Subject: Re: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing

Taking Base scenario.

Operational asks: 
- I'll own hiring cadence assumptions & headcount model. Need org-level headcount requests due 5/17.
- For the QBR deck, can someone confirm the target audience lines? Is this board+sales leaders or board-only? I want to tune narrative emphasis.

I can meet 5/14 2pm PT (works with Marissa) — suggest we carve 30m to reconcile toplines before we roll into slide consolidation.

Lauren
Head of Finance Planning

Date: 2026-05-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing

I'll take Downside. Quick observations: 
- Downside modeling needs stress tests for ARR retention and prefix/KV cache savings assumptions — I'll loop in Infra for capacity sensitivity.
- Timeline: 5/14 2pm OK for me; prefer to capture stress numbers as ranges rather than single-point estimates.

Subject: Re: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing

Folks —

I'll own the sensitivity table for cost per token and routing-policy impact (how batching/quantization moves economics in each scenario). A few asks: 
- Procurement exposure: if we need enterprise discounts for Upside partner motions, we should have preliminary term ranges; looped Procurement Services (external) for a heads-up.
- SLA ask: if we include Dedicated capacity cost assumptions, we need clear SLA delta; Ops to confirm by 5/14.

Agree 5/14 2pm PT to sync. For those building slides, please keep 1–2 bullets of risk mitigation per scenario.

Vivek
Chief Product Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Trajectory hypotheses & planning kickoff — targets, scenarios, QBR deck timing

Thanks all — nice quick alignment. Summary & next steps (action items):

- Marissa (Upside): deliver topline sketch + supporting assumptions by 5/13 EOD. File: scenario_hypotheses_v1.md (add sheet: Upside-table).
- Lauren (Base): finalize headcount model and ORG requests by 5/17; add one slide to qbr_template_v2.pptx.
- Mina (Downside): stress test retention and capacity sensitivity ranges by 5/14; liaise with Infra.
- Vivek: compile cost sensitivity table and procurement term outline by 5/14; coordinate with Procurement Services.
- Jonas: consolidate slides on 5/15 and run rehearsal 5/18 morning.

Meeting: 5/14 14:00 PT — 30m (calendar invite to follow).

If anyone hits a blocker (data, legal, procurement), flag immediately in this thread and drop the doc link. I'll consolidate all slide drafts into the Drive folder and produce a one-page executive summary before the board dry-run.

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
